title: Ubka sinni xagana
intro: afqado le rooci alqi yamaateemik afal diini xagana cule. ta muucih aydaadi fakkiimeh gidaaritteh addat, diini elle yangoorowem qibaadah oggol. Tah Yallih abbahta iyyaay?
clues: Anu Qur'aanal kunnabnale buxah marak suge.
Anu xagana cule inni ubkale baxa Yallih ayfaafah acayuh.
Anu xalte wak, lab baxa qammaala way, say baxa kinnim geemih cakkumsuteh suge.
Anu inni baxah Maryam axcuk muggaaqise, kibal kee ayfaf abaabisa migaq.
Anu inni baxa kee tet xayloh abaaro le sheytanak Yallih kalalu essere.
Yi baxi Yalli oggoleh, Nabiyyi Zakariyyah hanaawih gubat daffeyseh.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: tet alqi qibaadah aracal taceemih xagana culte
trial.answer: tet alqi qibaadah aracal taceemih xagana culte

location.label: Lafa le liyyitte
options: tet alqi elle daffeysen diini araca (mihrab)
is elle rabboh ayro caxah gubat
location.answer: tet alqi elle daffeysen diini araca (mihrab)

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Tet baxi oggol geeh yallih farmoyti zakariyyah gabat daffeysen.
is Yahya deqsita lab baxa yomcowwe
outcome.answer: Tet baxi oggol geeh yallih farmoyti zakariyyah gabat daffeysen.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
